name: sql-functions
description: Window frames, LAG/LEAD, string functions, CAST, COUNT(DISTINCT) and deduplicating set operators return MySQL-shaped rows.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE harness_functions (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, grp INT NOT NULL, val INT NOT NULL, label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
SELECT id, LAG(val) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS p, LEAD(val) OVER (ORDER BY id) AS n FROM harness_functions ORDER BY id
SELECT id, SUM(val) OVER (PARTITION BY grp ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS s FROM harness_functions ORDER BY id

SELECT id, CONCAT(label, '-', id) AS joined, UPPER(label) AS upper_label, SUBSTRING(label, 2, 2) AS slice, CHAR_LENGTH(label) AS characters, REPLACE(label, 'a', 'z') AS replaced FROM harness_functions ORDER BY id
SELECT id, CAST(id AS CHAR) AS rendered FROM harness_functions ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT grp) AS groups FROM harness_functions
SELECT id FROM harness_functions WHERE grp = 1 INTERSECT SELECT id FROM harness_functions WHERE id >= 2
SELECT id FROM harness_functions EXCEPT SELECT id FROM harness_functions WHERE grp = 2
